feeds.title: Millennial Revolution
feeds.description: Welcome to the Millennial Revolution, a FIRE (Financial Independence Retire Early) site started by two computer engineers/children's authors, FIRECracker & Wanderer, who retired at 31 to travel the world!

feeds.title: Boomer and Echo
feeds.description: I'm Robb Engen, the founder, and head writer. Boomer and Echo is a Canadian personal finance blog with smart ideas on how to save, invest and reach financial freedom.

feeds.title: My Own Advisor
feeds.description: My name is Mark Seed and I'm the editor, founder, and owner of My Own Advisor. Personal finance and investing is a growing passion of mine and I will be using this site to post my thoughts, opinions, and journey to financial freedom being my own DIY financial advisor.

feeds.title: Tawcan
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Bob Lai from Vancouver Canada. Tawcan.com is Canadian personal finance and dividend investing blog dedicated to chronicle my quest for joyful life and financial independence. My wife & I started our financial independence & retire early journey in 2011 after a financial epiphany. By investing in US & Canadian dividend stocks, we are aiming to achieve financial independence in our 40's & living off dividends.

feeds.title: Incoming Assets
feeds.description: We are Steph and Cel - a couple in our thirties, living in Vancouver, Canada. Inspired by some of our favourite money bloggers we decided to chronicle our own journey towards early retirement. Our goal is to be financially independent, meaning earning enough money through passive index investing to easily cover all expenses, by age 35.

feeds.title: Mrs. Money Hacker Blog
feeds.description: Mrs. Money Hacker is a personal finance blog founded in 2018 by Eileen Adamson, a personal finance expert and a chartered accountant. The blog provides practical tips and advice on how to save money, manage debt, and invest wisely. It also covers topics such as retirement planning, insurance, and mortgages.

feeds.description: Financial Independence, Personal Finance Advice

feeds.title: Objective Financial Partners Blog
feeds.description: Objective Financial Partners is a fee-only, advice-only financial planning firm based in Toronto, Canada that provides flat-fee and hourly fee-only financial planning advice to clients worldwide since 2012. Their blog covers topics related to financial, tax, and estate planning advice and similar topics.

feeds.title: Build Wealth Canada Blog
feeds.description: Investing and Personal Finance for Canadians

feeds.title: Freedom 35 Blog
feeds.description: I'm Liquid. Freedom 35 was started in 2010 as a public diary to track my journey to becoming financially independent before I turn 35 years old. Recently, I became financially independent in 2020. Check out my Freedom 35 Blog as it features relevant news & insightful commentary on personal finance, investing, early retirement, and passive income creation.

feeds.title: Canadian Dream: Free at 45
feeds.description: A blog about early retirement and happiness. By Tim Stobbs - an engineer in his late thirties with two kids.

feeds.title: Modest Millionaires
feeds.description: Mel documents her family's journey to financial independence while sharing her passion for financial education. As a coach, she helps individuals and families take control of their finances.

feeds.title: Retired At 48
feeds.description: We are an active, professional couple who retired from our careers at age 48 and wrote a book about our experiences. Retired at 48 is about one couple's journey to a pensionless retirement.

feeds.title: Eat Sleep Breathe FI
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Chrissy and I'm a FI fanatic! Join me as I share how we're reaching FI in our 40s, with kids, on one income, in high-cost Vancouver.

feeds.title: Jessica Moorhouse Blog
feeds.description: Explore Jessica Moorhouse's personal finance blog for expert advice on debt, credit, budgeting, and more. As a money expert and Accredited Financial Counsellor in Canada, Jessica's platform has evolved into one of Canada's top financial education resources. Her focus is on providing support and guidance to millennials in an easy-to-understand, non-judgmental manner.
